title: Bangarraju
desc: A deceased couple returns to Earth to help their grandson, who lost his way in life after familial and personal problems start to haunt him.

title: Makkhi
desc: After reincarnating as a fly, a murderer decides to take revenge on his rival, who killed him, and teams up with a woman to destroy the killer's life.

title: Laadla
desc: Raju, an upright union leader, can do anything at his wheelchair-bound mother's behest, even if it means breaking his own heart and giving in to a rude heiress.

title: Sky Force
desc: Brave heroes embark on a quest for truth as India and Pakistan enter an airstrike war that threatens to pose deadly consequences.

title: Simmba
desc: Inspector Simmba is a corrupt officer who works for a major smuggler. He finds his values challenged as the gangster's brothers assault his sworn sister.

title: Aliens 2042
desc: A group of survivors band together to fight extraterrestrials that have invaded Earth. Despite facing constant threats from humans and aliens alike, they are determined to reclaim the fallen planet.

title: Rock On 2
desc: The music band members, once separated due to the conflict, reunite and organise a rock concert, but the local authorities oppose them.

title: Hamari Adhuri Kahani
desc: Half a decade after her husband went missing, Vasudha, a single mother, falls for Aarav, a hotelier. However, her missing husband, Hari, returns, thereby creating a rift between the two lovers.

title: Rocket Gang
desc: A group of friends visits a new resort, but their excitement is short-lived when they experience supernatural activities and are confronted by the ghosts of some young children.

title: Tholi Prema
desc: Fate offers Aditya and Varsha the opportunity to rekindle their youthful romance years after personality differences compelled them to go their separate ways.

title: Annapoorani: The Goddess of Food
desc: Annapoorani, a girl born into an orthodox Hindu family, aspires to become a top chef. However, she faces obstacles that include prejudice and conventional beliefs.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Two adorable kids, a quirky mother-in-law and a happy-go-lucky friend help a heartbroken wife bring a straying husband back from the other woman's tangled embrace.

title: Toilet: Ek Prem Katha
desc: Jaya marries Keshav but is disappointed to learn that there is no toilet in his house. As a result, Keshav tries to pacify her with temporary arrangements.

title: Judaai
desc: Shashikant and Gauri get married in honour of his late father's will. But, marital problems soon arise when Gauri suspects him of having an affair, leading to a chain of misunderstandings.

title: Khoonkhaar
desc: Gagan, a brave young man, is unable to be with Sweety, his true love, due to her parents' disapproval of him. However, he vows to protect her after unknowingly saving her from gangsters.
